protocol.entry: approved ScanNet wrapper calls main locked scoring functions; Replica default GT whitelist unchanged

E1.definition: best-GT IoU improves/degrades on exactly the same observed reference surface

swap_partial.definition: best-GT IoU improves/degrades on exactly the same observed reference surface

baseline_to_E1.scope: complete fixed TSDF; not limited to observed evaluable GT vertices
baseline_to_E1.state_semantics: native evidence state stored alongside final postprocessed labels

baseline_to_swap_partial.scope: complete fixed TSDF; not limited to observed evaluable GT vertices
baseline_to_swap_partial.state_semantics: native evidence state stored alongside final postprocessed labels

E1_to_swap_partial.scope: complete fixed TSDF; not limited to observed evaluable GT vertices
E1_to_swap_partial.state_semantics: native evidence state stored alongside final postprocessed labels

partial_policy.direct: Original partial retirement: retain old_family_ids eligibility; remove only eligible adopted-mask overlap
partial_policy.history: Unchanged E1 core and expanded-region revision of retained original observations
partial_policy.accepted_masks: Unchanged; old observations outside old_family_ids remain separate candidates and may abstain
partial_policy.geometry: Original source projection, prior-core rule and expanded-region 2cm visibility
partial_policy.control: Original E1 source candidates, frame votes, aggregate votes, evidence and stage scopes reproduced

limitations: Single-scene conclusions; no inference of general ScanNet performance.
GT IDs are raw source IDs; no semantic names inferred.
Pair improvement means per-GT best IoU improvement, not a new TP.
Full-TSDF unassigned vertices differ from unassigned observed-evaluable GT vertices.
Main partition structure metrics and auxiliary geometry metrics are reported separately.
Fragmentation is a descriptive diagnosis; tracking or seed-selection causality has not been isolated.
Historical methods do not form a controlled repair comparison against this strict baseline.
Original audit key all_400_frames is retained; this run uses the locked actual frame count.
